name: Transaction Counterparty Data 11
definition: Specifies the details related to the parties involved in the securities lending transaction.

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Identification of the beneficiary who is subject to the rights and obligations arising from the contract.

TripartyAgent.name: Triparty Agent
TripartyAgent.definition: Identification of the third party that administers the transaction.

Broker.name: Broker
Broker.definition: Identification of the broker involved in the securities lending transaction.

ClearingMember.name: Clearing Member
ClearingMember.definition: Identification of the clearing member in the case where the trade is cleared.

SettlementParties.name: Settlement Parties
SettlementParties.definition: Identification of the parties settling the contract on behalf of the deliverer or receiver.

AgentLender.name: Agent Lender
AgentLender.definition: Identification of the agent lender involved in the securities lending transaction.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|	/Beneficiary Must be present| Or	/TripartyAgent Must be present| Or	/Broker Must be present| Or	/ClearingMember Must be present| Or /SettlementParties Must be present| Or  /AgentLender Must be present
